title: ARIA: Runtime Inspection and Amendment for Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.20780v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS), a local mistake can propagate as other agents build on it, turning a correctable error into a failed task. Diagnosing completed runs or repeatedly re-executing them to search for corrections does not provide a learned policy for intervening while execution is still in progress. We present Agent Runtime Inspection and Amendment (ARIA), a framework for learning when and how to repair ongoing multi-agent executions. Our key intuition is to turn execution-verified repairs into reusable supervision, moving repair search into data construction and training so that a learned model can intervene at runtime without repeatedly testing alternatives. translated_title: ARIA：面向多智能体系统的运行时检查与修正框架
translated_abstract: 在基于大语言模型的多智能体系统（MAS）中，一个局部错误会随着其他智能体在其基础上继续构建而不断传播，使原本可纠正的错误演变成整个任务的失败。诊断已完成的运行，或反复重新执行以搜索修正方案，都无法提供在执行仍在进行时进行干预的学习化策略。我们提出了智能体运行时检查与修正框架（Agent Runtime Inspection and Amendment，ARIA），用于学习何时以及如何修复正在进行中的多智能体执行。我们的核心直觉是将经过执行验证的修复转化为可复用的监督信号，把修复搜索过程转移到数据构建与模型训练阶段，从而使训练出的模型能够在运行时直接进行干预，而无需反复测试各种备选方案。首先，我们在四个多智能体框架、六个基准测试和八个宿主模型上收集了超过24,000条成功与失败的轨迹。基于这些轨迹，我们构建了ARIA数据集，据我们所知，这是首个大规模配对失败多智能体……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: ARIA框架通过将执行验证过的修复转化为可复用监督数据来训练模型，使其能在多智能体系统运行时实时干预并修复错误，并构建了首个大规模配对失败轨迹与经验证修复方案的ARIA数据集。
en_tdlr: ARIA is a framework that learns when and how to intervene in ongoing multi-agent executions by converting execution-verified repairs into reusable supervision, and introduces the first large-scale dataset pairing failed multi-agent trajectories with verified fixes.
